```{r setup, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# Reproducibility
set.seed(123)

# Packages
library(tidyverse)
library(MASS)     # Boston dataset
library(glmnet)   # Elastic net
library(BASS)     # BASS model
library(gt)       # Tables

```

```{r data-loading}

# Load Boston data
data("Boston", package = "MASS")
housing <- as_tibble(Boston)

# Train/test split
n <- nrow(housing)
train_idx <- sample(seq_len(n), size = floor(0.70 * n))
train <- housing[train_idx, ]
test  <- housing[-train_idx, ]

# Separate predictors/response
x_train_raw <- as.matrix(select(train, -medv))
x_test_raw  <- as.matrix(select(test, -medv))
y_train <- train$medv
y_test  <- test$medv

# Scale predictors using TRAIN statistics only
x_center <- colMeans(x_train_raw)
x_scale  <- apply(x_train_raw, 2, sd)
x_scale[x_scale == 0] <- 1

x_train <- scale(x_train_raw, center = x_center, scale = x_scale)
x_test  <- scale(x_test_raw,  center = x_center, scale = x_scale)

```

```{r elastic-net}

# Elastic Net with cross-validation to choose lambda
set.seed(123)
cv_enet <- cv.glmnet(
  x = x_train,
  y = y_train,
  alpha = 0.5,           # balanced elastic net
  nfolds = 5,
  standardize = FALSE
)

# Predictions on test set
pred_enet <- as.numeric(predict(cv_enet, newx = x_test, s = "lambda.min"))

# RMSE
rmse_enet <- sqrt(mean((pred_enet - y_test)^2))
rmse_enet

```
